recognize_zh: 這是風險分層表格加存活曲線與流程圖，非形態圖：依細胞遺傳分類再加上 FLT3-ITD、NPM1、IDH1/2、CEBPA、TET2、ASXL1、MLL-PTD、DNMT3A 等突變，把 AML 重新分為 favorable、intermediate、unfavorable 三組。
features: Composite table, survival curves and flow diagram; not a morphologic image
Top table: integrated risk classification combining cytogenetic risk with mutation status
Favorable: favorable cytogenetics, or FLT3-ITD-negative with mutant NPM1 plus IDH1/IDH2
Unfavorable: unfavorable cytogenetics, or intermediate cytogenetics with TET2, MLL-PTD, ASXL1, PHF6 (FLT3-ITD-negative) or TET2, MLL-PTD, DNMT3A, trisomy 8 without CEBPA (FLT3-ITD-positive)
Middle: test-cohort Kaplan-Meier curves separating genotype-defined risk groups
Bottom: reassignment of patients from cytogenetic to integrated risk classes with 3-year OS
describe_en: This composite figure (Patel and Levine, Hematology 2012) presents a revised AML risk stratification integrating cytogenetics with mutational profiling. The table assigns patients with normal or intermediate-risk karyotypes to favorable, intermediate or unfavorable groups according to FLT3-ITD status and mutations in NPM1, IDH1/2, CEBPA, TET2, ASXL1, PHF6, MLL-PTD and DNMT3A, and trisomy 8. Kaplan-Meier curves in a test cohort show distinct overall survival among these groups, and the flow diagram shows how mutational analysis redistributes patients so that the favorable and unfavorable groups enlarge while the intermediate group shrinks. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.
